    angles = base_angles + angle_rad
    x = cx + np.cos(angles)
    y = cy + np.sin(angles)
    return np.column_stack((x, y))

def _compute_max_proj_vectorized(centers, angles, outer_angle_deg):
    """Vectorized max projection computation."""
    theta_rad = np.deg2rad(outer_angle_deg)
